Dear Team,

We are delighted to share an important enhancement to our Group Medical Insurance Policy, reaffirming our commitment to the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families.

WHAT'S NEW?

1. ENHANCED MEDICAL INSURANCE COVERAGE
The sum insured has been increased from ₹3 LAKHS to ₹5 LAKHS per eligible employee family.

2. EXTENDED FAMILY COVERAGE
In addition to yourself, spouse, and dependent children, the policy now also covers parents.

We believe these enhancements will offer greater peace of mind by ensuring improved medical coverage and financial support.
